MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for Default Prove-Up Hearing.
Dept. 218, Comm. William R. Gargano, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Lois Jones, #3689.

Bernard J. Maryanski, Esq. appeared for plaintiff Eagle Refrigeration Heating & AC, Inc.
Herman Escasadillo, President of Eagle Refrigeration Heating & AC, Inc., was placed under oath and examined.
No appearance by defendant David M. Rosko, individually dba Strictly Custom General Contracting, aka Stricktly Customs General Contracting.
Default was entered against defendant on July 17, 2009.
Doe defendants were dismissed on July 17, 2009.

After hearing the evidence presented, and good cause appearing, the Court rules in favor of Plaintiff Eagle Refrigeration Heating & AC, Inc., and against the Defaulted Defendant David M. Rosko, individually dba Strictly Custom General Contracting, aka Stricktly Customs General Contracting as follows:

Damages/Principal - $27,500.00.
Prejudgment Interest - $1,084.32.
Attorney's Fees - $660.00.
Costs - $424.50, for a total judgment in the amount of $29,668.82.

Judgment was submitted to and signed by the Court.
